content.value_statement: Generic AI interfaces often feel repetitive, inaccessible, and visually weak. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished frontend work with clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides visual direction for pages, components, artifacts, posters, and apps.
Applies typography, color, spacing, motion, interaction, responsive, and UX writing principles.
Encourages working frontend code with production-grade structure and refined details.
Uses reference files for forms, focus states, loading states, modals, and keyboard navigation.
Promotes responsive layouts with container queries, fluid sizing, and real-device testing.
Highlights accessibility needs such as focus indicators, labels, contrast, touch targets, and reduced motion.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a complete framework or component library.
It does not inspect deployed pages unless the host agent runs separate verification tools.
It cannot guarantee brand compliance without project-specific assets and requirements.
Generated output still depends on the base model and the user prompt.

use_cases.title: Upgrade Product UI Direction
use_cases.description: Turn a rough feature idea into a stronger interface direction with typography, layout, motion, and copy guidance.

use_cases.title: Build Polished Components
use_cases.description: Create components that include responsive behavior, keyboard states, loading states, and accessible form patterns.

use_cases.title: Prototype Memorable Pages
use_cases.description: Move from generic landing pages to distinctive product screens with a clear visual point of view.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Single Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a polished pricing card for [product]. Include accessible states, responsive behavior, and refined typography.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply frontend-design to redesign this [page or screen]. Keep the existing content, but improve hierarchy, spacing, colors, and mobile layout.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Design System Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to define a visual direction for [app]. Include tokens, type scale, color roles, motion rules, and component patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Build and Validate an Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to implement [interface] in [framework]. Verify responsiveness, keyboard access, reduced motion, contrast, and visual polish.

output_examples.input: Create a dashboard for a small finance team.
output: A polished dashboard concept with a restrained palette, dense tables, clear status states, and accessible controls.
Responsive layout guidance for desktop review work and smaller approval workflows.

output_examples.input: Redesign a signup form for mobile.
output_examples.output: A form layout with visible labels, focus rings, validation on blur, plain error messages, and touch-friendly controls.

output_examples.input: Design a landing page for a new camera app.
output_examples.output: A first screen with product-first imagery, distinctive type, responsive layout, and interaction details that avoid generic templates.

best_practices: Give the skill concrete product context, user goals, brand constraints, and target devices.
Ask for accessibility, responsive behavior, and state design in the same prompt.
Review generated visuals on real screen sizes before accepting the design.
anti_patterns: Requesting only a beautiful page without content, audience, or product context.
Using the skill to force decorative effects when the product needs a quiet operational interface.
Accepting generated UI without testing focus states, text overflow, contrast, and reduced motion.

faq.question: Does this skill generate code?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides the host model to create working frontend code when the user asks for implementation.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It also covers components, apps, artifacts, posters, forms, and product screens.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers labels, focus rings, contrast, touch targets, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing design system?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide existing tokens, components, and brand rules so the output stays consistent.

faq.question: Does it make network requests or run scripts?
faq.answer: The reviewed skill files contain Markdown guidance only and do not define scripts or network behavior.
